tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers only H≤0.48, far shorter than the target horizon. The slow-horizon probe directly distinguishes and calibrates the guided adaptation mechanism.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter dual-horizon model to the pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not identify the slow adaptation needed for the H=22.3 forecast.
Fine short-trajectory sampling is less directly informative about the slow-horizon reversal.
It does not resolve the temporal identifiability ambiguity.
